name: Joshua Drake

bio.statement: Durham's city council page says the council appointed Drake mayor in January 2025.
bio.excerpt: Joshua Drake was appointed Mayor by City Council in January 2025.

bio.statement: Durham's council page says Drake was elected to the council in 2022 after three years on the planning commission.
bio.excerpt: He was elected to the City Council in 2022, and served on the Planning Commission for the three years prior.

bio.statement: Durham's council page says Drake holds a Georgia Tech degree and is a local commercial banker.
bio.excerpt: Josh has a degree from Georgia Tech, and is a local commercial banker.
